name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Dart
        uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - name: Cache Dart packages
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pub-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pub-

      - name: Install dependencies (marionette_mcp)
        run: dart pub get
        working-directory: packages/marionette_mcp

      - name: Install dependencies (marionette_flutter)
        run: dart pub get
        working-directory: packages/marionette_flutter

      - name: Generate version file
        run: dart run packages/marionette_mcp/bin/generate_version.dart

      - name: Check for version file changes
        run: git diff --exit-code packages/marionette_mcp/lib/src/version.g.dart

      - name: Check formatting (marionette_mcp)
        run: dart format --set-exit-if-changed .
        working-directory: packages/marionette_mcp

      - name: Check formatting (marionette_flutter)
        run: dart format --set-exit-if-changed .
        working-directory: packages/marionette_flutter

      - name: Analyze (marionette_mcp)
        run: dart analyze --fatal-infos
        working-directory: packages/marionette_mcp

      - name: Analyze (marionette_flutter)
        run: dart analyze --fatal-infos
        working-directory: packages/marionette_flutter

      - name: Run tests (marionette_mcp)
        run: dart test
        working-directory: packages/marionette_mcp

      - name: Run tests (marionette_flutter)
        run: dart test
        working-directory: packages/marionette_flutter

      - name: Audit (marionette_mcp)
        run: dart pub audit
        working-directory: packages/marionette_mcp

      - name: Audit (marionette_flutter)
        run: dart pub audit
        working-directory: packages/marionette_flutter
